en: The postcard shows a black-and-white image of a grand European public square with ornate multi-storey buildings featuring steep rooftops and a busy open area with trees and benches, suggesting a city center. The front includes the printed words 'Sundsvall.' and 'Torget.' as well as handwritten text. The reverse side is labeled 'BREVKORT.' with Swedish text, a 5 öre stamp from Sweden, postmarked 1901, and handwritten address details.
